preserved: One canonical JSON event per WebSocket text message; native retained-message reconnection, 50ms delay and per-endpoint deadlines
One long-lived NDJSON HTTP upload, newline records, transport handoff flush barrier and completion on close

Dotted-key collision preservation, Unicode and 70KB records match actual native ATOF source-file/wire output
Loopback plaintext/protected remote credentials, URL scheme and timeout validation; no credential-bearing redirect
